summary: Super League Enterprise, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Sales Agreement with Benchmark and StoneX to sell up to $2,229,000 of common stock through an at-the-market offering under its existing S-3 shelf. The company is not obligated to sell any shares and can suspend the program. Agents receive a 1.0% commission plus reimbursement of specified expenses. The offering terminates upon selling the full amount or earlier termination by either party. This is a routine equity financing arrangement, not a special situation. What to watch: potential dilution from future ATM sales under the agreement.
